;Disasters and accidents

;International relations
*[[Japan–South Korea relations]], [[Japan–South Korea General Security of Military Information Agreement|GSOMIA]]
**[[South Korea]] decides against extending the [[Japan–South Korea General Security of Military Information Agreement|General Security of Military Information Agreement]] (GSOMIA). South Korean officials express that the exclusion from [[Japan|Japan's]] preferred trade list on 12 August eliminated any benefit to maintaining the agreement. [https://www3.nhk.or.jp/news/html/20190822/k10012044721000.html (NHK)]

;Law and crime
*[[2018 Chemnitz protests]]
**A [[Syrians in Germany|Syrian]] man is jailed for [[manslaughter]] in relation to a stabbing in [[Chemnitz]], [[Saxony]], [[Germany]] last year. The killing sparked [[far-right politics in Germany|far-right]] protests and [[riot]]s in the city. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-49438847 (BBC News)]
*[[Eileen Sarmenta and Allan Gomez murder]]
**[[Department of Justice (Philippines)|Philippine Department of Justice]] Secretary [[Menardo Guevarra]] and [[Bureau of Corrections]] (BuCor) Director-General [[Nicanor Faeldon]] says that former Calauan Mayor [[Antonio Sanchez (politician)|Antonio Sanchez]] is ineligible under a 2013 law that credits good conduct time allowance (GCTA) for an early release from prison. [https://newsinfo.inquirer.net/1156631/doj-bucor-sanchez-ineligible-for-release (''Philippine Daily Inquirer'')]

;Politics and elections
*[[2020 Democratic Party presidential primaries]]
**[[Washington (state)|Washington]] [[Governor of Washington|governor]] [[Jay Inslee]] drops out of the presidential primaries to focus on his [[2020 Washington gubernatorial election|re-election bid]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2019/08/21/us/politics/jay-inslee-2020-campaign.html (''The New York Times'')]

;Science and technology
*The second [[GPS IIIA]] satellite is successfully launched by a [[Delta_IV#Delta IV Medium|Delta IV Medium]] rocket from [[Cape Canaveral Air Force Station]]. It is the last launch of the Delta IV Medium vehicle. [https://www.orlandosentinel.com/space/os-bz-delta-gps-advance-20190821-ohgyewv2f5d2jivurkiexqznje-story.html (''Orlando Sentinel'')]
*The uncrewed [[Soyuz MS-14]] mission to resupply the [[International Space Station]] commences. Its launch is a successful test of a Soyuz spacecraft atop a [[Soyuz-2]] launch vehicle, which will replace the [[Soyuz-FG]] as the carrier rocket for Soyuz spacecraft starting next year. [https://www.nasaspaceflight.com/2019/08/soyuz-ms-14-upgrades-ferry-skybot-robot-station/ (NASASpaceFlight.com)] [https://www.space.com/russia-launches-humanoid-robot-on-soyuz-spacecraft.html (Space.com)]
